# Option A build plan (generated by option_a_plan.py)

60 GHz model: MARL paper Table III at 23 dBm. Conducted loss reproducing a path = FSPL + O2 − 48 dB. Chain per path: 20 dB pad and splitter at each sector port, 3 dB jumpers, one programmable attenuator. Off-beam = on-beam + 30 dB (15 dB sidelobe per end). Cut = 95 dB.

## Microwave chains

| Hop | Fixed pads | Programmable attenuator at rest | At t0 |

| W1–CORE | 60 dB (2 × 30) | 10 dB + fades | 95 dB (cut) |
| CORE–E1 | 60 dB (2 × 30) | 10 dB + fades | 95 dB (cut) |
| W1–W2 | 60 dB (2 × 30) | 10 dB + fades | unchanged |
| E1–E2 | 60 dB (2 × 30) | 10 dB + fades | unchanged |

Set each microwave chain so the received level sits at the IP-50's nominal operating point (check the datasheet for the band); the programmable attenuator then adds fades for DPIR and cuts the core spokes at t0.

Totals: 8 IP-50, 6 TG nodes + 2 TG terminals, 18 V-band paths, 8 splitters, 18 V-band ports.
